Liquid Glass

Illustration·by @LynelDesign·2026-08-23·inspora page·original post

What it is

Glassmorphic calendar button set (illustration): a frosted-glass pill 'Add to My Calendar' with a glossy translucent calendar icon (orange-to-blue gradient header, glass body), and a matching circular blue-glass button with an up arrow - soft inner glows, edge highlights, and diffused shadows sell the glass material.

Media

Frame-by-frame

media 1
Close crop of the pill: white frosted body (translucent, blurred backdrop), glass calendar charm with gradient header and two binder rings, soft grey label type.
media 2
Circular button: radial blue glass (bright cyan core fading to white edge), white up-arrow glyph, thick specular rim light bottom-left, set into a frosted panel corner.

Build prompt

Recreate this glass button pair. Pill: 48px radius frosted panel - background white at 55% + backdrop-blur 24px, 1px white/60 inner border, soft outer shadow (0 12px 32px black/8). Icon: 28px calendar drawn as glass - body = white/30 fill + 1px white/70 stroke + backdrop-blur, header = orange->blue horizontal gradient at 80% opacity with two 3px white rings on top. Label: two lines, 13px muted 'Add to' over 17px grey-700 'My Calendar'. Circle button: 96px disc, radial gradient #7DD3FC center -> #F0F9FF edge, white arrow glyph with 1px blue-200 inner stroke, plus a crescent specular highlight (white/80 blur 4) hugging the bottom-left rim and a thin top edge light; shadow is a diffused blue-tinted bloom (0 16px 40px #7DD3FC/30).
